en: Added responsive phone and tablet extension layouts with reachable product and language controls.
Stabilized Safari popup startup geometry and aligned host/extension version, build, signing, and bundle metadata.
Clarified local-first product and review information in Settings.
Added a user-initiated stable update check that opens only the matching public GitHub Release and never installs automatically.
zh-CN: 新增手机与平板扩展布局，确保产品标题和语言入口在触屏设备上可达。
稳定 Safari 弹窗启动尺寸，并统一主应用与扩展的版本、构建号、签名和 Bundle ID 元数据。
在设置页补充更清晰的本地优先产品与审核说明。
新增用户主动触发的稳定版更新检查，仅打开匹配的公开 GitHub Release，绝不自动安装。

en: Inspect and transform common developer data formats.
Use focused browser utilities from one developer toolbox.
Run supported tools across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari.
zh-CN: 检查并转换常用开发数据格式。
